title: Core Oracle Apps Database Administrator (M)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Oracle Apps DBA with strong expertise in Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) R12.2.x and Oracle Database administration. The candidate will be responsible for managing, supporting, maintaining, and troubleshooting Oracle EBS and database environments, along with middleware, backup, monitoring, and production operations. Key Responsibilities Administer and support Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) R12.2.x environments. Perform EBS administration activities including ADOP, AutoConfig, AD/TXK utilities, cloning, patching, upgrades, and maintenance . Manage and support Oracle Database 11g/12c/19c environments. Administer Oracle RAC, ASM, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, RMAN, and Data Guard . Perform database backup, recovery, refresh, migration, and troubleshooting activities. Manage and support Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle Fusion Middleware, Forms, and Reports . Monitor database and application environments and perform performance troubleshooting and optimization. Support Oracle Solaris 11.x and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments. Manage backup operations and integration with Veritas NetBackup . Monitor environments using Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) and other enterprise monitoring tools. Develop and maintain automation using Shell scripting, SQL, and PL/SQL . Handle production incidents, problems, changes, releases, and environment maintenance activities. Provide support for release cutovers, production deployments, and go-live activities . Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and vendor teams for issue resolution and production support. 

Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
